create_bounding_box: create a BoundingBox from coordinates with a specified coordinate origin
scale_bounding_box: scale a BoundingBox to a target page size using old and new Size objects
compute_intersection_over_union: compute the IoU between two overlapping BoundingBoxes
build_enclosing_bbox: build an enclosing BoundingBox that covers a list of bounding boxes
check_bounding_box_overlap: check if two BoundingBoxes overlap horizontally and vertically
